description: This file defines a custom exception class 'UnauthorizedException' used in the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It encapsulates an HTTP response object and extends the base PHP Exception class.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: A custom exception class that includes an HTTP Response, used for handling unauthorized access scenarios in the authentication plugin.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UnauthorizedException with a Response object, message, code, and optional previous Throwable.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Returns the Response object associated with this exception.

methods.name: setResponse
methods.description: Sets the Response object for this exception.
